title: 单位正方形内的最均匀采样网格
titleEn: The most uniform sampling mesh in the unit square

knownBest.source: Our paper gives an exact triangular-lattice construction attaining 2/√3 and proves the global lower bound. The continuous optimum is proved. Finite-decimal coordinates cannot attain it; the current certificate is not claimed optimal on the nine-decimal grid.
